notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[b]- 40+ New Crafting Recipes[/b]
-- Starter/Advance Weapons & Tools, Workstations, and armor to name a few!
[b]- 20+ New Building parts and decorations![/b]
-- Beds, Cabinets, Rugs, Glass Windows, Spiked Walls, to name a few!
[b]- 20+ New Items[/b]
-- Bandages, Groschen and Pelts to name a few!
[b]- 208 Wearable clothing items![/b]
-- (70 craftable) (138 bought through traders)
[b]- 9 New Workstations[/b]
-- Workbench (Used to craft various crafting stations and other basic items.)
-- Forge (Shapes your metals into various weapons, armors and other items.)
-- Furnace (Smelts ores into ingots.)
-- Smoker (Used to cook food.)
-- Furnishing Station (Used to craft storage, furniture and decorations!)
-- Tailoring Station (Used to craft clothing and accessories.)
-- Mortar (Used to make dyes)
-- Water Storage (Used to hold rain water)
-- Anvil (Used to craft various upgrades, repair kits, and open geodes!)
[b]- Simple Farming[/b]
-- Cabbage and Peppers for you to plant, grow and eat.
[b]- Audio[/b]
-- Some ambient sounds and in game music.
[b]- Saving[/b]
-- Everything (should!) be saving correctly now in both SP and MP saves. Make sure you save your games before exiting! Auto saves are 5 mins by default.
[b]==Demo Island Additions==[/b]
-- There is a basic economy now, everything is no longer free. (Please need feedback as to what is grindy or to easy!)
-- Random loot from crates and dead bodies! (Loot-able crates and chest will be found at Ruined Settlements and Bandit Camps/Outposts)
-- Balance to weapons and armor (Please need feedback as to what armor and weapons are trash or OP!)
-- 2 New Villages (3 in total)
-- 6 Followers through out the map (3 dogs, 3 humans)
-- 10 New Bandit Camps/Outposts
-- 4 Ruined Settlements
-- Bears, Deer, Zombies, Bandits and Villagers spawn across the map, mostly on the dirt roads. (Bears and Deer in the both of the Pine Forests)
-- 4 Ride able horses scattered around the map.
Reminds: Start on a new save/session don't use your save from the old demo. 
& please submit any bugs, thanks!
